fact: Amnesty International says Addis Standard managing editor Million Beyene was abducted by national intelligence agency members on 15 April 2026 and held two weeks without access to his lawyer or family, which it says appears linked to his journalism.

Human Rights Watch reports the Ethiopian Media Authority permanently suspended two Deutsche Welle correspondents, alleging noncompliance with media and hate speech laws, after a nine-correspondent suspension from 23 October 2025.
OONI data shows Ethiopia blocked access to Facebook, Telegram, TikTok and YouTube from 9 February 2023, with the blocks apparently lasting until 17 July 2023.
Access Now says new internet shutdowns in Tigray, Ethiopia, are raising fears that the population cut off for over two years during the civil war will be disconnected again.
